flagged.urlStatus: Loaded. It supports the general claim (XAI helps people understand why a model decided something), but it has nothing on lending or loans.
flagged.evidence: "Explainable AI (XAI) is a set of tools and frameworks that can be used to help you understand how your machine learning models make decisions." and "provide clear and understandable explanations of the reasoning that led to the model's output" (https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/why-you-need-to-explain-machine-learning-models).
flagged.problem: The fact is correct, but you can read the answer off the name: "Explainable AI helps ... understand the reasons" just restates the term. A player who has studied nothing gets it right. It also does not test the business implication the exam guide asks about.
flagged.suggestedFix: Make it test a real misconception, e.g. FALSE: "Using explainable AI on a loan-approval model guarantees that the model's decisions are free of bias." Explanation: explainable AI shows which factors drove a prediction, which helps people find and question bias, build trust and meet review or regulatory needs. It does not remove bias by itself; fairness still has to be evaluated and fixed. Same source URL.
